text:
Sarah K: Heads up — Conductor SI flagged a blocker in their staging run for AcmeRetail. They hit image pull + gRPC connectivity failures during the deploy window. Can we get an oncall bridge?

Raj P: +1, we should spin up a quick bridge. Details from SI: image pulls fail with 403 from our marketplace S3 mirror, and service-to-service gRPC times out on the private subnet.

Maria P: I already pinged infra, but need redwood infra/marketplace folks on the call. Suspect image signing metadata mismatch or presign expiry.

Aaron D: I'm free now. I can join bridge and check marketplace logs. Sharing go-to command to tail the signing service logs:
```
kubectl -n marketplace logs -l app=signing --since=30m --tail=200
```

Conductor Oncall Bot: Bridge created: #bridge-conductor-230123 (dial-in link: https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/230123) :phone:

Sarah K: Thanks — Conductor SI says the customer test VM is in us-west-2 in their VPC with private link to our dedicated gateway. They saw 403 with header X-Image-Signature: missing.

Raj P: If headers are missing, maybe our ingress proxy stripped them. Aaron, can you check envoy/audit logs for requests from partner IP range 34.210.0.0/16 ?

Aaron D: On it. Quick grep:
```
kubectl -n ingress logs envoy-abc | grep "34.210." | grep 403 | tail -n 50
```
Found ~80 hits around 16:03 UTC. Looks like presign token expired: query param expires=1700000000 vs now=2301234567.

Maria P: Whoa that's a massive mismatch — implies the SI toolchain minted presigns with wrong epoch or we decoded incorrectly. Could be an env var in their provisioning script or our signing lib pulled a stale dependency.

Sarah K: Conductor SI reports they deployed marketplace adapter v1.6.2 built last week. They also mentioned a custom image proxy that rewrites headers.

Raj P: Two parallel actions: (1) infra to rotate signing config / verify epoch calc, (2) ask Conductor SI to bypass the proxy for a test pull to isolate. Maria, can you coordinate (1)? Aaron can hold the bridge and collect logs.

Maria P: Yep. I'm checking the signing service code — there's a lib that reads time from ENV TIME_OFFSET for tests. In staging TIME_OFFSET was accidentally set to -600000000. Pushing a fix now.

Aaron D: Bridge notes: captured these traces and example headers, uploading to the incident GCS bucket now: gs://rw-incidents/acme-retail/230123/trace.log

Conductor Oncall Bot: Conductor SI ack'd the bridge and will attempt a direct pull in 2 mins.

Conductor Oncall Bot: Direct pull attempt result: 200 OK. Image pulled successfully.

Sarah K: Good isolation — looks like their proxy was the issue but signing config bug also exists. Both need follow-ups.

Raj P: Action items:
- Maria: submit PR to fix TIME_OFFSET default + add unit test (owner: Maria P)
- Aaron: attach envoy/audit + signing logs to the partner ticket (owner: Aaron D)
- Sarah: coordinate a short postmortem with Conductor SI to align on proxy rewrite rules and marketplace presign expectations (owner: Sarah K)

Maria P: PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/pull/423 — added test and fallbacks.

Aaron D: Logs uploaded and linked in ticket #PART-1123.

Sarah K: Thanks team. Closing bridge in 10. Will follow up with a joint announcement checklist update for marketplace partners to highlight known proxy patterns to avoid. :white_check_mark:
